_about: The engine's lineage between releases (dev/tools/engine_lineage.js; DECISIONS Session 39). Each link records an engine change that left every result unchanged: the six 12-seed release panels made by the new engine have the base's fingerprints. domtest accepts a published run file whose engine differs from the page's only through such a chain. The round's release remakes the panels and starts a new base.
proof: node harness.js testbed 12 release ENV --json=DIR/r20-ENV.json and the same with --years=40 (DIR/r40-ENV.json), ENV ref, adv, st; fingerprints by dev/tools/panel_hash.py (every result, not the run's own record)

base.what: the engine of the published v5.2 panels (commit 42cd8b9; unchanged in v5.2.1 and v5.2.2)
base.madeBy: the v5.2.2 harness at commit 0701615 (v5.3 B1's before-runs, Oct 6, 2026; DECISIONS Session 38)

links.change: v5.3 B2: the accounting check (ACCT, off by default) and the correction switch SURP_CUT_MARKUP (off by default)
v5.3 B3: households (HOUSEHOLDS, off by default): composition on its own stream, household budgets with childcare, child allowance, pooling, household decisions and BLEI cost
v5.3 B3d: the household reading's measures (reporting only; HOUSEHOLDS off by default)
v5.3 B3f: what BU can buy (BU_SCOPE, 'core' by default; 'hub' adds transport and, for households, childcare)
